static_traits.name: Zhang Di
static_traits.social_status: Social support system not strong, tending to handle problems alone
static_traits.medical_history: Never undergone psychotherapy; no major physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: Since a month ago, a regular car-buying client stopped returning my calls, leaving me with persistent anxiety and pressure; I believe he must think my work is terrible, which triggers inferiority and self-doubt, making me fear rejection and thus avoid contacting other clients.
basic_info.core_demands: The decisive factor in seeking counseling this time: realizing that anxiety and self-doubt about work ability were affecting overall physical and mental health and work performance.
growth_experiences: Experienced rejection at work in the past, affecting self-esteem in the short term but not yet escalating to the current degree; never received any psychotherapy before, and no major physical illness.

special_situations.event: A customer who often bought cars has stopped returning calls for about a month
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a client does not return my calls, it proves my work is terrible and I cannot be trusted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to contact the client in different ways, but ultimately stopping for fear of rejection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He must think I am terrible / he hates me

special_situations.event: When needing to proactively contact other clients
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If rejected again, it means I am not suited for this job; further failure must be avoided
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding calling clients, keeping a low profile, not interacting with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will reject me / no one will answer my calls

special_situations.event: When thinking about work-related interpersonal interactions and performance pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make one mistake, the future will all be ruined; only perfection counts as qualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding exposure of imperfection and failure through self-doubt and withdrawal
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never sell cars / everything will go wrong

special_situations.event: Being around colleagues or thinking colleagues may see my shortcomings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If colleagues see my flaws, they will think I am a failure and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Isolates from colleagues, reduces interaction to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me / they think I am a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, especially to receive affirmation from clients and colleagues for work performance
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being rejected, seen as incompetent, and negated
defense_goal: Avoiding negation through self-isolation and reduced external contact
Maintaining fragile self-esteem's safety through withdrawal and avoidance

object_relations.self_representation: An employee who is not good enough and prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Critical others who may reject or belittle oneself at any time (clients/colleagues)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to proactively contact clients while the other side is silent or has not yet responded
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding the other's silence as negation of one's own incompetence (projecting self-doubt as others' negative views)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using an empathetic and gentle tone, asking open-ended questions to help distinguish facts from assumptions; lightly challenging projection content, inviting evidence listing and alternative interpretations, avoiding blame and opposition.

manifestations: Weak social support system, tends to bear problems alone
Isolating from colleagues out of inferiority
outcomes: Decline in work performance and increased avoidance behavior

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets the client's silence as 'he thinks I am terrible'
Assuming colleagues will look down on them

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Avoiding calling clients for fear of rejection
Burying one's head at work, reducing interaction for self-protection

exception_events.target_problem: When needing to contact clients, the client usually avoids calling for fear of rejection, leading to fewer sales opportunities and decline in work performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last year thought a big deal would be lost, but after he proactively called the client, they ended up buying three cars — a clearly better outcome than anticipated.
exception_events.reason: Different approach/mindset: more confident at the time, not letting fear dominate, choosing to proactively contact the client; situation: the client may have had a real need then.

positive_force: Once proactively reached out in a major sales situation and achieved notable success (the customer bought three cars at once)
Having tried contacting the unresponsive client in different ways, showing some willingness to act
negative_force: Fear of rejection leading to avoiding calls
Negative cognitive patterns of overgeneralization, mind reading, and predicting the future reinforcing self-doubt
Inferiority and self-denial, reducing interaction with colleagues
Weak social support, tending to bear pressure alone

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids proactively contacting clients (especially phone communication)
antecedent: Clients not returning calls for a long time
When thinking about or needing to make work-related client contact
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing predictions of rejection and self-doubt (equating silence/no response with negation and failure)
target_behavior.function: Briefly escaping potential rejection to temporarily lower anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced client contact, lost sales opportunities, decline in work performance, further worsening inferiority and social isolation
